title: sinSeriesPartial: the partial sums of the sin(1) series
statement: CReal.sinSeriesPartial := CReal.sumRange CReal.sinTerm -- the partial-sum sequence n |-> sum_{k<n} sinTerm(k), mirroring CReal.cosSeriesPartial exactly at sinTerm's own term sequence. A total, axiom-free definition.
